items.raw_excerpt: Gary White travels the world teaching people how to get the most out of their working dog. Lately, he's seen strong demand for working dogs, in part thanks to ABC's hit series Muster Dogs.
items.summary_en: Gary White is a dog trainer who travels the world teaching people about working dogs. He says the ABC TV show Muster Dogs has created strong demand for working dogs. More farmers now want well-trained dogs to help with livestock.

items.raw_excerpt: Após ausência de sete anos da competição, o campeão mundial e medalhista olímpico não só venceu a prova em 44s60, como quebrou o próprio recorde da competição (44s76) estabelecido por ele na semifinal. Alison volta a competir neste sábado (25) nos revezamento 4 x 400m.
items.summary_en: World champion and Olympic medalist Alison dos Santos returned to competition after seven years away. He won the 400m race at Troféu Brasil with a time of 44.60 seconds, breaking his own competition record. He will compete in the 4x400m relay this Saturday.

items.title_en: Alison dos Santos Wins First 400m Gold at Troféu Brasil with Record Time

items.title_original: Alison dos Santos fatura 1º ouro nos 400m no Troféu Brasil com recorde

items.raw_excerpt: It's already a paradise for fishers in the know from across Australia, but locals say the remote Limmen Bight Marine Park has vast, untapped potential as a tourism hot spot.
